thread:
kat: heads-up - new int4/int8 canary shows bump in funcall json parse failures on toolbench this morning. canary-bot: canary 17699 report -> https://infradash/canaries/17699  spike ~03:14 UTC :warning:
omar: any recent prompt or tokenizer changes?
kat: prompts unchanged. quant build switched to per-channel int4 fallback int8 for hot layers + more aggressive act clipping. also reduced batch-window 60ms->25ms for latency test.
mira: sample error from logs:
ERROR: JSONDecodeError: Expecting value: line 1 column 1 (char 0)
RESPONSE_PREVIEW: "\u0000\u0003{\"action\":\"assign\",\"args\":{\"owner\":\"...\"}}"
leading control bytes in some outputs.
omar: looks like streaming-prefix-noise. often first-token drift or framing. did streaming chunking change?
kat: no direct framing change, runtime shows slightly higher variance in chunk sizes after batch tweak. kvcache enabled on canary.
mira: ran quick inspect on 40 failures: concentrated on short toolcall responses that start with '{'. model sometimes emits 0x00/0x03 before the brace.
infra-bot: alert meta: failure_mode=streaming-prefix-noise, model=phoenix-int4-canary-17699, rate=2.6%, baseline=0.1%
kat: immediate plan:
- rollback batch-window to 60ms on the canary pool (temp)
- push a lightweight streaming scrub that trims leading control chars (<=0x1F) before JSON parse (opt-in flag)
- enable token-first-token histogram logging for 1% traffic
- run kv-cache on/off microbench (10k calls) comparing first-token dist for int4 vs fp16
omar: scrub is fine short-term but make it auditable (capture raw+cleaned) so we don't mask a true regression. add onboarding gate: fail quant candidate if nonprintable-leading-token-rate > 0.2% on 5k sample.
mira: opening scrub PR & tests: https://git.redwood/repo/pull/7901 includes unit tests that ensure idempotence and raw capture.
kat: canary flag deploy started (commit=d3f5a) est=4m
omar: early kv microbench note: int4 first-token distribution shows small shift toward lower-value tokens under current encoding; full run ETA 30m.
mira: if kv amplifies the issue we may need to add a noop guard token or adjust prefix-encoding for quantized models.
kat: will collect scrubbed vs raw metrics and convert to compact postmortem. reconvene 10:00 PT for follow-up. :thumbsup:
